deployment_conditions: Deploy only after the separate actual V9/compiled scientific review exists and its exact SHA is known. This source receipt provides no scientific approval.
Freeze this guard and the exact approved compiler/base/supporting package, and use the unchanged complete original producer bundle identified by the reviewed new study.
Ensure the replaced old CPU waiter has no admission and no attached GPU work before stopping only that CPU coordinator; preserve every protected allocation/holding continuation.

If the holder changes/disappears during integration, the second resource check stops before training. Preserve any already written valid scientific admission and diagnose the handoff; do not delete/reinterpret it or bypass the producer resource checks.
limitations: Mocked tests establish lifecycle ordering and artifact checks, not actual resource availability or scientific evidence.

An allocation can change after any read; the postintegration check and unchanged frozen pipeline revalidate ownership. This guard does not promise atomic resource ownership across a long evidence rehash.
No numerical, data, optimizer, hardware mapping, budget or scientific policy change is introduced.
reviewed_boundaries: Requires CPU Slurm, the exact fresh study path, caller-pinned actual independent review SHA with scientific approval, exact44b803new14check compiler, report SHA and matching report/review/manifest binding. A source-only review or unseen analysis cannot satisfy this entry condition.

Checks the original producer source directory matches the manifest, requires a nonempty retained producer file manifest and rehashes every listed file. Actual source/model/data completeness and integrity remain enforced by strict evidence integration and the unchanged frozen producer worker gates.

Waits up to48hours for the existing holder verifier to confirm a live owned high-priority/spec-priority full8GPU protected allocation. During the wait it writes only a resource-wait receipt and no scientific admission or GPU work. It allocates/cancels no jobs and mutates no holder/successor.

Rechecks approval/report bytes after resource availability, invokes the strict separately reviewed14check compiler integration with independent review and complete artifact rehash, then verifies the same live holder again before handing off.
The only training entry is the unchanged source-frozen pilot_pipeline in its original producer PYTHONPATH. Its allocation, source, scientific review and run/controller locks remain active.

validation.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -B -Werror -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_pilot_resource_handoff.py
